turns.doctor_question: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi, Dr. Smith. Um, well, I guess I'm here because work has just been getting really hard lately. My hands feel like they’re moving through glue at the salon. Like, even just doing basic stuff like sectioning hair or mixing color takes me forever now. 

Which really sucks because color is usually my favorite thing to do. Actually, this one client came in on Tuesday wanting this super icy platinum blonde, which is honestly so hard to maintain, you know? Like, you have to use purple shampoo every single time you wash it or it gets super brassy. Plus she has well water at her house, so I told her it’s going to turn orange in like two weeks anyway. My aunt has well water and it completely ruined all her nice white towels. They’re all this weird rusty color now, and she was so mad because she bought them at Target, the really nice fluffy ones from that one specific brand... 

But anyway, what was I saying? Oh, right. Yeah, my hands just feel stuck. People at the salon have definitely started noticing I’m just way slower than I used to be, and I don't really know why.
